name: knowledge_consolidate
description: Two-phase knowledge consolidation. First call with action="read_all" to get all entries; then call with action="execute", delete_ids=[...], and/or save_entries=[...] to apply a consolidation plan. The agent analyzes which entries are useful, obsolete, or mergeable. Lossless guarantee: read_all shows truncated previews, so when consolidating existing entries into a merged one, ALWAYS pass save_entries[].source_ids listing the source entry IDs — the tool appends the FULL original content of each source to the saved note (after a '--- 原文保留（合并来源）---' marker) and automatically deletes those sources. Only entries explicitly listed in delete_ids (or auto-added from source_ids) are removed; consolidation never compresses or drops original content.

action.description: "read_all" returns every entry for analysis; "execute" applies deletions and saves.

delete_ids.description: List of entry IDs to delete (only used when action="execute").

source_ids.description: IDs of existing entries being consolidated into this new entry. The tool appends the FULL original content of each listed source to the saved note and automatically deletes those source entries (replaced by this merged entry). Always list source_ids when merging existing entries so no content is lost.

source.description: Optional source context recorded with the entry (e.g. user command, project name).

save_entries.description: New entries to save (only used when action="execute"). Saved after deletions.
